scopeBoundary: Independent content, citation, metadata, figure, formula, number, uncertainty, comparison-scope and resource-state review. No production report was edited by this reviewer; no training, inference, simulation, checkpoint loading, dataset download, third-party code execution, Git operation or notification was performed.

method.primarySourcePolicy: Main claims were checked against each fixed arXiv v1 HTML/PDF. Every related-work mechanism was checked against that work's own primary paper and formal proceedings page when available. Current resource claims were separately checked against official repositories, author/project pages and Hugging Face APIs.

authorEvidenceUse.note: The author artifact was used to locate fixed primary files, resource snapshots and official images. Its conclusions were not accepted as review results; the reviewer reopened and read the retained evidence independently.

claimChecks.taskAndMetric: Lines 27 and 60-77 correctly define 30 ego-frame waypoints at 5 Hz over six seconds, model-score Top-1 selection, meter-valued Top1ADE@6s and positive radar gain as an error reduction. Future GT in figure 2 is training/evaluation construction, not inference input.
claimChecks.samplesFramesAndMissingModalities: The DSERT split 7,052/1,305/2,293 and MAN split 13,113/1,643/1,647 sum to 10,650 and 16,403. DSERT uses 0.1 s matching; MAN uses 2 Hz anchor keyframes and 5 Hz interpolated targets. Camera is current-frame; radar/LiDAR combine current plus one motion-compensated previous frame. Dense BEV reserves zero-filled missing-modality slots; query methods concatenate only active tokens.
claimChecks.trainingAndUncertainty: All configurations use 80 epochs, AdamW 1e-4/1e-4, batch 16 and seed 42. The report correctly marks the absent multi-seed variance, per-cell counts, complete compute budget and diffusion checkpoint gate.
claimChecks.tableAndArithmetic: All reported table II/III values, eight radar-only single-modality wins, 22/24 radar additions, 19/20 DSERT adverse-condition comparisons and 24/24 MAN condition comparisons match. The source prose says the Sparse Query L-to-R+L regression is 0.75 m, while rounded table III gives 3.26-2.52=0.74 m; report line 123 explicitly preserves and explains this discrepancy. The second exception is 3.37-3.06=0.31 m.
claimChecks.comparisonBoundary: K-Radar evidence is kept at detection/perception, and DiffusionDrive is identified as an adapted planning style rather than an exact reproduction of its original training and evaluation.
claimChecks.followUp: The proposed matched three-seed Sparse Query L versus R+L experiment separates minADE coverage from Top-1 ranking, includes an ego-history baseline, and has sample-count, variance and alignment stop conditions.
